display_long_description:
**Winner of “Education Experience of the Year” at The Polys 6th Annual Immersive Awards.**

Welcome to Cosmic XR, your immersive gateway to space, the universe, and beyond, right in your room. Explore galaxies, planets, moons, and black holes through intuitive, hands-on interaction.

[media]

# Cosmic Web

Witness the largest known structure in the universe, a vast network of filaments stretching across billions of light-years, where galaxies are woven by gravity.

[media]

# Laniakea Supercluster

Discover the immense region our galaxy calls home. Spanning over 500 million light-years, Laniakea contains countless galaxy clusters, including Virgo, the Local Group, and the Milky Way.

[media]

# Milky Way

Trace the graceful arms of our home galaxy, rich with glowing nebulas and starlight. Explore the Milky Way from an impossible vantage point.

[media]

# Andromeda

Encounter our neighboring galaxy as its spiral arms unfold, slowly moving toward a future merger with the Milky Way.

[media]

# Solar System

Step into a dynamic model of our planetary system. Observe orbital paths and watch planets move in real time.

[media]

# Planet Details

Hold and examine planets up close. Rotate Earth, explore Jupiter’s storms, and inspect moons like Titan and Ganymede.

[media]

# Galactic Center – Black Hole

Approach Sagittarius A*, the supermassive black hole at our galaxy’s core. Witness light distortion and extreme gravity.

[media]

# Spacecrafts

Explore human engineering up close. Grab and inspect the ISS, Mars rovers, and the Space Shuttle.
